hooks.command: npx --no specpilot hook pre-tool-use; s=$?; if [ "$s" -eq 0 ] || [ "$s" -eq 2 ]; then exit "$s"; fi; printf 'Blocked by SpecPilot: the SpecPilot hook failed (exit %s), so no edit is safe. The error is above.\nSTOP: do not try to fix or work around the hook yourself. Ask the human how to fix it, one question at a time (like the grill phase), and wait for the answers before doing anything else.\n' "$s" >&2; exit 2
